pages.title: Frostbitten Golem
pages.text: A victory over Frostbitten Golem is shared across the world. Together with the other prerequisite victories in this branch, it opens the way to Maledictus; these subordinate encounters can be completed in any order.
Cartographers and wandering traders may sell this reusable locator. Use it to mark the exact encounter site and open the map. Nether locators work only while you are in the Nether.
